_readme: Send each example below as a separate POST request to your webhook URL to test different classification outputs.

examples._label: Test 1 — Order not arrived (expect: general/high/negative/needs_human: true)
examples.name: Ali
examples.message: My order has not arrived. It has been 10 days since I placed it and I still have no tracking update. I need this resolved immediately.

examples.name: Sophie Laurent
examples.message: I was charged twice for my subscription this month. My bank shows two payments of $79 on June 1st and June 8th. Can you refund the duplicate charge?

examples.name: Marcus Webb
examples.message: I cannot log into my account. When I click the login button the page just spins and nothing happens. I have tried Chrome and Firefox. This has been happening for two days.

examples.name: Priya Nair
examples.message: Hi, I just signed up yesterday and I am trying to figure out how to invite my team members to the workspace. Where do I find that setting?

examples.name: David Chen
examples.message: Just wanted to say the new dashboard update is fantastic. The analytics section is exactly what I needed. Thank you for listening to feedback!
